actions: Require a generation-qualified normalized model fact because the current planner does not consume model year and no accepted VDS patterns exist.
Keep plain Prius/RX and other ambiguous branches inert.
Record passive_capture_unavailable when adapter monitoring is unreliable.
Never interpret source extended-address notation as a plain 11-bit route.
Add only exact model/year research routes.
Do not generically enumerate 29-bit targets or extended addresses.
Read preferred ISO identity where service 22 supports it.
For service-21 branches, preserve identity-unreadable as an outcome rather than changing session.
Repeat identity on an independent connection before family matching.
Read candidates only after route response.
Keep decoders disabled until guided validation matches.
Preserve NRC, timeout and transport failure separately.
Stop on safety, budget, cancellation or low information gain.
Use platform_known_route_knowledge_incomplete when model classification exists without an applicable route.

priority_model: exact model/year + immutable source + reached route + user value - traffic cost - ambiguity
